label: 01. June 7, 1844
title: June 7, 1844
caption: The press runs for the first and last time. Insiders break their silence. The truth will out.
style: Americana, cinematic folk, slow build, orchestral swells, male vocals, anthemic, storytelling, acoustic guitar, strings, dramatic, building intensity
role: Album opener - sets the scene, establishes stakes, introduces the whistleblowers

label: 02. Forbearance
title: Forbearance
caption: They begged him to repent. He said he'd rather be damned. Now forbearance has ceased to be a virtue.
style: Folk rock, Americana, building intensity, male vocals, righteous anger, acoustic to electric, stomping rhythm, raw emotion, defiant
role: The whistleblowers' manifesto - why they had to speak

label: 03. Seven Wives
title: Seven Wives
caption: "What a thing it is for a man to be accused of having seven wives, when I can only find one." He stood at the pulpit and lied.
style: Dark folk, sardonic, minor key, acoustic guitar, sparse arrangement, male vocals, bitter, ironic, storytelling, slow burn
role: The public lie vs. private truth - bitter irony

label: 04. Ten Thousand Miles
title: Ten Thousand Miles
caption: She crossed the ocean to find God. She left everything behind. She didn't know what waited.
style: Folk ballad, Celtic influence, female vocals, hopeful turning melancholy, acoustic guitar, violin, gentle build, emotional, bittersweet, atmospheric
role: The journey to Zion - hope before the fall

label: 05. Positively No Admittance
title: Positively No Admittance
caption: A room with a warning on the door. An oath sworn under penalty of death. "God has revealed that you are mine."
style: Dark folk, haunting, female vocals, sparse, minor key, acoustic guitar, cello, slow, intimate, devastating, emotional

label: 06. The Tender Tree
title: The Tender Tree
caption: Sent away until the talk died down. Robbed of what only death can restore. Dry sorrow drinks her blood.
style: Sparse folk, mournful, female vocals, slow, acoustic guitar, cello, ethereal, grief-laden, atmospheric, fading, haunting, minimal

label: 07. Under Condemnation
title: Under Condemnation
caption: The revelation said wives who refused would stand condemned before God. Obey or be damned. There was no escape.
style: Dark Americana, female vocals, ominous, building intensity, organ undertones, minor key, accusatory, powerful, defiant
role: The theological trap - damned if you do, damned if you don't

label: 08. The Revelation
title: The Revelation
caption: Austin Cowles sat in the High Council when Hyrum read the revelation. Plural wives. Sealing against all sins. He could not teach such laws.
style: Folk, storytelling, male vocals, serious tone, acoustic guitar, deliberate pacing, testimonial, building conviction, Americana
role: The High Council testimony - what Hyrum read aloud

label: 09. Many Gods
title: Many Gods
caption: They taught there were innumerable gods above our God. That He could fall. That we could rise. They called it progression. The Expositor called it blasphemy.
style: Progressive folk, building complexity, male vocals, philosophical, acoustic to fuller arrangement, questioning, expansive then collapsing, atmospheric

label: 10. The Great Throat
title: The Great Throat
caption: They preached sacrifice. They preached gathering. The wealth flowed in and was swallowed by one great throat, from whence there was no return.
style: Blues-influenced folk, sardonic, male vocals, groove-based, acoustic guitar, upright bass, wry delivery, accusatory, dark humor
role: Financial exploitation - the gathering as grift

label: 11. King and Lawgiver
title: King and Lawgiver
caption: Prophet. Mayor. General. Presidential candidate. "We will not acknowledge any man as king or lawgiver to the church. Christ is our only king."
style: Anthemic folk rock, defiant, male vocals, building power, drums entering, acoustic to electric, protest song energy, Americana, driving rhythm
role: Political ambitions - church and state merging

label: 12. The Inquisition
title: The Inquisition
caption: April 18th. A council called in secret. Tried, condemned, and cut off. They never knew until it was done. Our law condemns no man until he is heard.
style: Dark folk, tense, male vocals, minor key, sparse arrangement building to intensity, accusatory, dramatic, ominous, building dread
role: The secret trial - cut off without a hearing

label: 13. Habeas Corpus
title: Habeas Corpus
caption: Fugitives fled to Nauvoo and found protection. The Mayor's court overruled federal warrants. "A sink of refuge for every offender who can carry in spoils enough to buy protection."
style: Driving folk rock, urgent, male vocals, faster tempo, acoustic guitar with percussion, journalistic, exposÃ© energy, Americana
role: Charter abuses - Nauvoo as sanctuary for criminals

label: 14. Citizens of Hancock County
title: Citizens of Hancock County
caption: Francis Higbee's letter to his neighbors. Arise in the majesty of your strength. The August election approaches. This is the dreadful conflict.
style: Rousing Americana, anthemic, male vocals, building throughout, full band by end, call to arms, passionate, urgent, folk rock, protest energy
role: Francis Higbee's rallying cry - call to action

label: 15. The Burning
title: The Burning
caption: One hundred men. Scattered type. The flames consuming truth. Three days later, they printed their last word with fire. Seventeen days later, Carthage.
style: Cinematic folk, dramatic, male and female vocals, building intensity, strings, percussion, flames as metaphor, tragic, powerful, anthemic resolution
role: June 10, 1844 - the destruction of the press

label: 16. Sudden Day
title: Sudden Day
caption: They burned the press but not the truth. Lo, it is sudden day. The dark deeds of foul fiends shall be exposed from the house-tops. A departed spirit cries for vengeance.
style: Sweeping folk, triumphant yet mournful, male and female vocals, full arrangement, orchestral elements, anthemic, resolution, hopeful, building to climax then resolving to quiet

label: Bonus. 1890
actSubtitle: Epilogue / bonus track — a modern coda asking what hasn't changed.
caption: Epilogue / bonus track — a modern coda asking what hasn't changed.

label: Theme. The Reckoning
title: The Reckoning
caption: Theme song for Act V — The Reckoning.
role: Theme / overture for Act V — The Reckoning
